Prototype v4 vs v5

Same screens, same state, 390 px phone width. v5 is a fix pass, not a redesign: the allergen warning at the cook moment, one consistent set of numbers, and accessibility. Keyboard focus rings and reduced motion don't show in still screenshots; press Tab in the v5 preview to see the focus ring.

Home

  • Stat pills now match the rest of the app: "67% verified · 4 use this week · 5 to buy".
  • Stir-fry card shows "+ 0.75 lb chicken" instead of implying you have everything.
  • Verdict says "2 members" (the real household), without "· label data".
  • Nav labels and small text are bigger.

Home · "Why this?" opened

  • v4 said "4/4 ingredients on hand ... needs 0 purchases". That was wrong: chicken is 0.75 lb short.
  • v5 says 3/4 fully on hand and 1 purchase, already on your shopping list.

Miso salmon · Cook this (the big one)

  • v4: the sheet expanded inline at the bottom, listed deductions only, no allergen warning at the moment you commit.
  • v5: pops up over the recipe. Maya's sesame warning and the caveat sit at the top, before the deductions.
  • Closes with Esc, tapping outside, or Cancel. Button now says what it does: "Log meal, record deductions".

Shopping

  • Looks the same as v4: the checkbox is the same size. What changed is the invisible tap area around it (now 44 px) and the whole row now checks the item off when tapped (easier one-handed in a store).
  • Garlic reads "1" instead of "1 head", matching the built app (stored as 1 each). Remove and Undo get a 44 px tap area without looking bigger.

Assistant (post-MVP preview)

  • v4 claimed you had everything for the stir-fry; v5 says chicken is 0.75 lb short and on your list.
  • Blocked example now matches Maya's real profile (peanut), using the copy deck's exact wording. v4 used a tree-nut example she doesn't have.
  • "See recipe" button is a real 44 px button.

Inventory

  • Header now reads "9 items · 67% verified" to match Home.
  • Confirmation tray count matches its rows (Strawberries, Mushrooms), same as on Home.
  • Segment buttons and chips are a little taller (44 px tap targets).
